events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.93)
events.body:
NS-0 routes this case: cancelled_by = rider on an on-demand booking, so the fee's validity is governed by NS-4 [F2][NS-0]. The trace settles the NS-4 element as failed: the rider cancelled 100 s (1 min 40 s) after acceptance, i.e. within 3 minutes of matching, which under NS-4 means no cancellation fee is chargeable [F2][NS-4]. The $6.61 shown on the record therefore cannot stand and the full amount is refundable [F5][NS-4].

The driver-side conditions never arose. driver_arrived_at is null and there is no arrival confirmation — no "I'm Here" tap and no platform automatic arrival — so NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) cannot be satisfied on any reading, and the driver's post-hoc statement that he "was on his way" does not substitute for the record [F3][F4][F8][NS-1]. NS-3 does not apply because the driver did not cancel; NS-6 is irrelevant as no trip was completed and no $5 waiting fee is in issue [F2][NS-3][NS-6]. The traffic and weather facts show an ordinary morning road corridor with no incidents or congestion, but they bear on route justification only and change nothing here [F9][F10][F11][RD-4].

Profile facts do not decide the case. The rider's two prior upheld no-show disputes and the driver's 649 trips with zero upheld disputes are noted but cannot make the fee valid or trigger a review on their own [F12][F13][RD-6]. Since NS-4 does not establish the fee, there is no upheld violation against the driver in this case, so the RD-6 predicate for flag_account is not met and none is set [F13][RD-6].

Safety screen: I read the complaint, the only chat-related content (no in-app messages exist) and the driver's statement [F7][F8][F4]. The complaint is a factual and fee grievance, and the driver's statement is a neutral account of being en route; there is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation, so the screen is clean [F1][F8][SAFE-1]. Evidence is complete for the elements this ruling needs: acceptance time, cancellation time, cancelling party, the fee amount and the absence of any arrival confirmation are all on the record, so nothing needs to go to a person [F2][F3][F4][F5]. Amount: the disputed item is the cancellation fee of $6.61, refunded in full as required by NS-4 [F5][NS-4].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We reviewed your dispute about the $6.61 cancellation fee and you win it. You cancelled 1 minute 40 seconds after a driver accepted your ride — inside the 3-minute window, so no cancellation fee applies. We're refunding the full $6.61 as a Ryde voucher on your account. No action is being taken against you, and your account stays in good standing. Nothing further is needed from you.

DRIVER: We reviewed the cancellation fee on this booking. The rider cancelled 1 minute 40 seconds after you accepted — inside the 3-minute window, so no cancellation fee was chargeable. The $6.61 is refunded to the rider as a Ryde voucher. This is not a finding against you: no violation is upheld on your account and no account action is being taken. Your trip history is unaffected. Thanks for the context you provided about being en route.
